title: MTB Mudguard – Lightweight in Carbon Fiber Look
descriptionHtml:
Rainy trail, muddy back

After the first wet ride of fall you know exactly where the stripe is: straight up your back, and in your face on every downhill.

The solution: a guard that takes the mud for you

A lightweight mudguard in a carbon fiber look that mounts in a few minutes and keeps mud, gravel and water spray away from you and the bike – on both MTB and road bike.

Features

  • Your back stays free of mud
  • Doesn't show on the weight – light and flexible
  • Mounts in a few minutes – no special tools
  • Fits MTB and road bike
  • Sleek carbon fiber look

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
